requirement_match.summary: Three approved sections, shared copy, responsive reading width 800px desktop, mobile no overflow, keyboard CTA verified. Product content gate passed.

findings.summary: Shared .page CSS overrides the intended 800px reading width.
findings.resolution: Scoped selector increased to .page.purchaseTerms. Browser reports readingWidth 800, viewport/scrollWidth 1440; fresh screenshot inspected.
